decisions.decision: The question on the parameters of COA and Friends of Eagle House was tabled to the next COA meeting, and the Director will include it in the Director's Report at the June meeting.
decisions.quote: doreen said since this was not on the agenda, the question will be tabled until the next coa meeting.

decisions.decision: Sue Doherty will be in charge of Meals on Wheels and the Director will do in-house meals, since staff is bare bones in case of illness.
decisions.quote: since the staff is bare bones in case of illness sue doherty will be in charge of meals on wheels and doreen will do in-house meals.

decisions.decision: If the override does not pass, one food service staff member will take the training; if so, the Director will take it on June 6.
decisions.quote: if so doreen will take it on june 6.

decisions.decision: Director's evaluation: the sub-committee will compile the evaluation results, the COA will vote on the compiled score later, and a sub-committee meeting was requested for May 25.

decisions.decision: Jim Hays was told to request the term-limit waiver at the next meeting.
decisions.quote: he was told to request the waiver at the next meeting.

decisions.decision: The board was asked to come up with a date and plan for the 45th Anniversary celebration next fall.
decisions.quote: he asked us to come up with a date and plan for a celebration next fall.

budget_items.topic: FY13 COA budget and override impact
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY13 budget is in a holding pattern; if the override passes it will be restored, with 5 added custodian hours and 1 or 2 added kitchen hours, and the impact on 2,300 people is stated as a dollar figure.
Work on the Formula Grant is delayed depending on the override vote; the amount per person is fluid until the government decides, and there is no penalty for being late. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: there is no penalty for being late.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Training for a food service staff member depends on whether there is money for one or more people; no cost printed.
budget_items.quote: if there is enough money chris mccarthy will take it in july or august.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Financial Report was presented to the board; no figures are printed in the minutes.
